title: When a fix round's failing check output matches the previous round's byte for byte, rerun the check before starting another implementer round

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-194833-6309, project ork, item S631:

When a fix round's failing check output matches the previous round's byte for byte, rerun the check before starting another implementer round

Evidence: the implementer reported the same daemon failure text, run id and time in rounds 2 to 4, and the round 4 check then passed
